Name: Let Me Rest
Author: GukelZ
Description:
[b][color=#6aa84f][size=6]DESCRIPTION:[/size][/color][/b]

In Stardew Valley we have many beautiful locations and decorations, but in the most of case we don't pay attention to that.

Let Me Rest exists to make that things important! Now the decoration and locations around the map makes the difference to your gameplay!

You can sit, ride a horse or just stand still to recover stamina, having many multipliers based on the decoration around you and the ambient that you are.

Each furniture had a different multiplier, based on the rarity, price and cuteness!


[color=#6aa84f][size=6][b]MOD FEATURES:
[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Recover stamina when seated.
[*]Recover stamina when riding a horse.
[*]Recover stamina when stopped.
[*]Beatiful and calm locations add multipliers to stamina restoration.
[*]Interior and exterior decoration add big multipliers to stamina restoration, decore your farm!
[*]Buff system (ONLY FOR SINGLEPLAYER).
[*]Base multiplier configurable via config.json and command.
[*]Multiplayer support.
[/list]
